class: Locale-less login URL treated job as the tenant site
symptom: The login fallback opened /ChipotleCareers/job/login and returned a missing page.
root_cause: The fallback assumed every Workday path began with locale/site.
why_tests_missed: The live portal variant was not represented in regression fixtures.
fix: Recognize an optional locale and preserve the actual tenant prefix and post-login redirect.
prevention: Retain synthetic coverage for the observed portal contract and preserve neighboring working behavior.
